This is my small maize plot near the house, only about 0.09 hectares. I have been farming here for many years. I will apply DAP and urea from the cooperative because maize grows strong with fertilizer, and I will also put cow manure on it as I do every season. I keep my own maize seed from last year's harvest — it has always served me well. My family will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting together. We do not use chemicals for pests, and we depend on the rains God sends; we have no irrigation.
